instruction: Add LibreOffice Writer to your favorites

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding LibreOffice Writer to favorites. Initial apps are ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. Evaluator checks for all 4 apps using check_gnome_favorite_apps.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts favorite apps list using gsettings command
Metric correctly parses the string output and compares using set equality (order-independent)
Expected value is semantically correct: includes all 3 initial apps plus 'libreoffice-writer.desktop'
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both that LibreOffice Writer was added AND that original apps remain
Length check ensures no extra apps were added
State accessibility is guaranteed: gsettings persistent state requires no postconfig
